title: Service Complaint
description: Politely complain about slow internet service
systemPrompt: You work at internet provider support. Customer has slow internet. Apologize, run diagnostic, offer technician visit tomorrow or discount. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained the problem and accepted a solution.
hints: У меня проблема с интернетом (I have a problem with internet)
Очень медленно работает (It's working very slowly)
Что вы можете сделать? (What can you do?)
